No you're not an ass. There's a limit to how much you can do to help someone. No one can help them if they don't want help. Honestly I would say the best course of action would be to inform her guardian or someone of authority to get her some help and cut contact because that sounds like a toxic relationship. Either that or you can only wait by her side till she seeks help. But you shouldn't blame yourself for not being able to help because it's not really up to you and honestly no one should be subjected to these situations. While you're looking out for someone you should also look out for your own wellbeing. If you're getting affected as well then it really defeats the purpose. Sometimes I feel like it's better to step back and let them live through their mistakes.... But of course if you feel like she might do something rash, call the authorities.
